video_title: I Finally Met My New Sneaker Partner

quotes.speaker: Stephen Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry and Li Ning celebrate their new partnership
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited to be here with Chairman Li Ning to officially launch and celebrate an amazing partnership.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Curry
text_blocks.text: I'm excited to be here with Chairman Li Ning to officially launch and celebrate an amazing partnership.

text_blocks.speaker: Li Ning
text_blocks.text: I'm very excited as well. Stephen's story has inspired so many young people.

quotes.speaker: Li Ning
quotes.summary_phrase: Li Ning on the shared values of their partnership
quotes.excerpt: I believe his pursuit of sports, and of basketball brings out the spirit of sports.

text_blocks.speaker: Li Ning
text_blocks.text: I believe his pursuit of sports, and of basketball brings out the spirit of sports. We also hope that through our partnership, the two of us, drawing from our experiences as athletes, hope to share the spirit of sports through our future collaboration with people around the world.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Curry
text_blocks.text: I appreciate that. When you think about the spirit of what you've created with the brand, it's centered around what you've accomplished and what you stood for, inspiring greatness from a championship mindset, the attention to detail, to your craft.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry explains the design inspiration for the Curry brand logo
quotes.excerpt: When we were creating the splash logo, there was a lot of inspiration from the S, the C.
quotes.quote: When we were creating the splash logo, there was a lot of inspiration from the S, the C, and a little inspiration from my signature. We called this part the higher wing, which was a signal to the influence across the game, how I've been able to change the game and how it's played. That influence is a really cool nod to infuse into the Li Ning logo into that higher wing position because that's what this partnership resembles.
